beginner.title: Get started with Node-RED
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Node-RED, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Describe the process
beginner.outcome: You can: turn a repetitive task into a rule
beginner.practice: Write one "when X, do Y" rule from your work

beginner.title: Build a first flow or app
beginner.outcome: You can: build a simple working automation or app
beginner.practice: Build and test one simple flow or app

intermediate.title: Logic and data
intermediate.outcome: You can: add conditions, loops and data handling
intermediate.practice: Add a condition and a lookup to your flow

intermediate.title: Reliability
intermediate.practice: Add an error alert and review usage limits

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Node-RED
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Node-RED distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Node-RED
expert.outcome: You can: use Node-RED's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Govern automations
expert.outcome: You can: run automations safely for a team
expert.practice: Document and hand over an automation to a colleague

expert.title: Integrate Node-RED into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Node-RED with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Node-RED to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Node-RED well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Node-RED" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
